disposition_reason: Table 4 prints mean ± SD (mg/kg, dried tissue) of ten elements by portable XRF in seven body parts, including meat, of 11 market tilapia from Calapan City.

study.design: Market survey of tilapia body-part distribution of metals with health risk assessment
study.origin: Inland farmed tilapia, Calapan City watershed, Oriental Mindoro, Philippines (abstract)
study.market: Local fish vendors in 11 barangays of Calapan City
study.method: Oven drying at 65 °C, powdering, portable XRF (Olympus Vanta, soil mode calibrated with ICP-OES results)
lod: XRF LOD mg/kg: As 1, Ba 15, Cd 2, Cu 1, Fe 1, Hg 1, Mn 3, Ni 3, Pb 1, Zn 1 (Table 2)
study.qa: Manufacturer standard reference and ICP-OES comparison for calibration; no CRM recovery reported

findings.notes: Pooled over 11 fish bought from vendors in 11 barangays of Calapan City (one fish per site per part); dried at 65 °C before portable XRF. Values below LOD were replaced by a number one step below the LOD before averaging (p. 4).

unresolved: Many printed means are below the XRF LOD because sub-LOD readings were replaced by a value one step below the LOD before averaging; such means are flagged.
Fins nickel cell prints both "6.36 ± 2.11" and "ND".
Several SDs exceed their means (e.g. fins As 0.09 ± 3), consistent with substitution and skewed data.
The text layer of the PDF has overlapping duplicated text on some pages; tables were read from rendered page images.
